_comment: The Content Type column takes ONE value from `formats`, spelled exactly. It is column 3 of
the house sheet and it reaches the blog writer under its own header, so the value is an
instruction about the shape of the piece and not a label on it: a Comparison anchor is a
different article from an FAQ (entity), and a writer handed the wrong one writes the wrong
`vertical_examples` is NOT a menu. The skill derives one or two category-specific formats
from what the site scrape actually found, and these are examples of the SHAPE such a
format takes. A derived value is legal in the Content Type column; a value invented to
dress up a generic piece is not.

structural_quotas._comment: Counted across the WHOLE sheet, kept rows included on a rewrite.
structural_quotas.Comparison anchor: exactly 1, where the category supports honest multi-way comparison
structural_quotas.PR outreach: 0 to 1, and only against a genuine data asset. Most roadmaps have zero.
